comparison.objective: Intercept and stop a freely rolling bottle before it falls; candidate commissions and locks an industrial shock absorber through iterative impact tests.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed moving-object interception and gentle arrest versus recessed hex-key engagement, captive setscrew loosening, fine collar rotation, counterholding, relocking, and guarded cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle must remain on the worktop/drainboard below 1 cm/s for 1 s without ever crossing an edge. Candidate instead requires two ≥0.85 J impact cycles within the rated velocity range, ≤12 mm stroke, no hard-stop strike/overload/excessive rebound, and retained collar setting. Candidate rebound and drift tolerances are not numerically specified.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities and outcomes differ materially: reactive interception of an unrestrained object versus tool-mediated adjustment and empirical validation of a retained damping setting.
